recorded.final_text:
The Robertson Media Center (RMC) has 10 equipment categories, split between items you can just walk up and grab and gear you need to reserve in advance.

*Reserve ahead (LibCal booking form)*
• Reserve Cameras
• Reserve Stabilizers and Camera Accessories
• Reserve Light Kits
• Reserve Microphones and Audio
• Reserve Live Sound and PAs
• 3D Printers _(requires an online orientation + in-person training before your first reservation; check in at the front desk before using)_

*Walk-up (no reservation needed — first come, first served)*
• Walk-Up Camera Equipment
• Walk-Up Audio Equipment
• Walk-Up VR Equipment
• Walk-Up Media Equipment

You can browse and book everything here: <https://cal.lib.virginia.edu/equipment?lid=241|RMC Equipment Booking>
